Package ascent.model

Class StrengthExercise

java.lang.Object
ascent.model.Exercise
ascent.model.StrengthExercise
public class StrengthExercise extends Exercise
A weight-training exercise: a number of sets, each with a number of reps lifted at a given weight.

  • Constructor Details

    • StrengthExercise

      public StrengthExercise(String name, String date, String notes, int sets, int reps, double weightLbs)
      Constructs a strength exercise.
      Parameters:
      name - the lift name (e.g. "Bench Press")
      date - the date performed, in YYYY-MM-DD form
      notes - optional notes
      sets - number of sets, must be positive
      reps - reps per set, must be positive
      weightLbs - weight used per rep, in pounds, must not be negative
